title: Expert Care, Built Around Your Goals
intro: Transparent pricing for bioidentical hormone therapy, tailored to your individual needs. Choose the medical support programme or individual consultation that suits you.

packages.title: General Hormone Consultation
packages.best_for: Everyone who wants a hormonal perspective on their complaints.
included: Holistic assessment with analysis of your existing findings

packages.title: Basic Medical Support
packages.best_for: Women who want to begin bioidentical hormone therapy simply, with structured medical support.
included: 60-minute initial medical history with detailed analysis of your complaints and symptoms and review of available laboratory results and external findings
Individual laboratory planning where additional examinations are needed
30-minute medical follow-up to discuss your laboratory results and create your individual treatment plan
Organisation of your first hormone supply, including the medical prescription
Two 20-minute video follow-ups within the first three months

packages.title: Intensive Medical Support
packages.best_for: Women with more complex symptoms who want more intensive medical guidance.
included: All services included in Basic Medical Support
Four 20-minute video follow-ups in total within the first three months
A separate 30-minute video consultation on nutrition, weight, metabolism, gut health, sleep and stress

packages.title: Follow-up Assessment
packages.best_for: Patients who are already in therapy.
included: Discussion of your current lab results
First prescription and ordering of your hormones

items.text: All prices exclude laboratory services. Blood is drawn and analysed separately, by your GP or gynaecologist or at a laboratory we recommend.
Hormone preparations are not included. For women in menopause they usually cost about €1.00–1.50 per day.
Initial consultations after pregnancy, in perimenopause and for the thyroid are also €180 for 60 minutes. Returning patients can book a short video consultation (approx. 20 min) for €45.
The programmes include no ongoing medical advice or therapy adjustment by email or SMS. Medical questions are discussed in the included video follow-ups.
